title: The Azure Great Canon of Devouring
summary: A guarded great canon of the Azure Sky that teaches the drain of marrow and ends in a touch that consumes a soul outright.

title: The Twin-Court Treatise of the Open Maw
summary: A treatise on two maws held open side by side in the soul that swallow a company's force and are never shown to the court.

title: Manual of the Hawk's Final Feast
summary: A manual of the hawk that plummets on a soul for a last meal and is gone before the foe has understood the loss.

title: The Wind-Sworn Great Reckoning of Hunger
summary: A great reckoning of a hunger that rides the wind and takes its fill from the souls it passes before it settles.

title: The Canon of the Oath Unspoken
summary: A Gale canon of the oath that is never spoken aloud and the hunger that keeps it until a vow itself is devoured.

title: Treatise of the Bearing Famine Compendium
summary: A treatise of famine held on a fixed bearing so that every soul that crosses the line is starved and none may leave unmarked.
